_comment: Offered to the owner at the Stage A intake stop and written to <target>/.claude/settings.local.json only on the owner's word. A skill's own allowed-tools pre-approval lasts one turn and this skill stops for the owner many times; these rules are the same patterns, made to last for the session. Local settings are not committed (.gitignore). {{SKILL_DIR}} is the skill's directory, substituted when rendered.
